intro: Goldwell the Elder is a Lunar Festival quest offered by Elder Goldwell in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. Honoring him reflects the enduring tradition of seeking out ancestral spirits across the snowbound dwarven lands. In exchange for your respects, he bestows a token of ancestral blessing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
